text:
maya: quick heads-up — planning a shared-config flip tonight for header-routing. order: router -> runtime -> api -> console. change window 23:00-23:30 PT. wanted to sync pins/rollbacks before i press the button.

deploy-bot: scheduled wave id=wf_9283, canary config: 5% for 10m, 25% for 10m, then 100%. auto-rollback hooks enabled.

ben: +1 to order. can we pin runtime to v2.4.1 during the flip? there are subtle kv cache key changes in v2.4.2.

sam: @ben runtime team ok to pin v2.4.1. we need explicit rollback criteria though. propose: 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 2m OR p99 latency increase >150ms vs baseline for 5m.

leo: agree with sam. also add error-class check: any spike in header-parse-errors >0.1% triggers rollback. router change touches parsing.

maya: noted. i'll update the release notes and the runbook. who will own the router step? @leo?

leo: will own router. plan: flip shared-config flag `use_new_header` true on router cluster A, watch for errors, then flip B. if safe, advance to runtime.

anita: for console: it's a UI-only flag behind feature gate. delaying console until after runtime is fine. i'll hold the final console deployment until you signal.

ops-bot: reminder: update oncall rotation + page rules for tonight. page if deploy-bot auto-rollback triggers or if >2 services report degraded.

sam: adding small runtime toggle we'll use if kv eviction misbehaves. snippet for the runbook (put in config section):

```
# runtime toggle during flip
runtime:
  kv_cache_eviction: "legacy"   # fallback: legacy vs aggressive
  header_compat_mode: true
```

maya: excellent. i'll put that in the playbook and attach the exact deploy-bot wave id.

ben: release notes checklist: updated model pin, runtime pin v2.4.1, router migration notes (backwards compat), rollback criteria, canary windows, contact list. once the doc is up i'll give :thumbsup:.

deploy-bot: wf_9283 is live for scheduling. next action: @leo to start router canary at 23:00 PT. confirm ready by 22:50 PT so we can do quick dry-run.

leo: i'll be at my desk. dry-run @ 22:50. :white_check_mark:

maya: perfect. final call — anything else? otherwise i'll pin the runtime version and kick off the dry-run.

sam: one more: monitor the KV eviction metrics and header-parse-errors dashboards (dash links in runbook). set alerts to 1m granularity for the first 30m.

anita: i'll hold console deploy and stand by for the 'go' slack from maya.

ops-bot: autopage rule created: page on wf_9283.auto_rollback OR service_degraded_count>2.

maya: ok starting the dry-run at 22:50. will call 'go' in this thread if green. thanks all. :rocket:
